Arthur Vance
Senior Portfolio Research Note · 2026-11-17 · 5 min read

Before the opening bell on 2026-11-18, our public sector sentiment gauge reads 10.6 out of 100 (Extreme Fear). $SMH closed the prior session at $457.91 (-31.54% from its trailing 52-week high, with a 14-day RSI of 34.9), while $XLV closed at $182.14 and $QQQ settled at $655.94.

Numbers like these are most useful when they lower the temperature in the room. When sentiment compresses into deep fear, headlines grow urgent even though valuation dispersion has already cooled substantially. Conversely, when sentiment stretches above seventy-five or eighty, crowds treat extrapolations as certainties. Observing both $SMH and $XLV side by side keeps attention anchored on full-portfolio balance (currently modeled at 80% $SMH : 20% $XLV in our historical series) rather than intraday noise.
